title: PEDS-PLAN – Pediatric Precision Laboratory Advanced Neuroblastoma Therapy
description: A multi-center clinical trial for newly diagnosed high-risk neuroblastoma patients. Molecular tumor boards selected one of six targeted agents based on tumor-normal whole exome sequencing and tumor RNA sequencing data.
